task: Write a Python script that implements a simple stack data structure with push, pop, and peek operations, runs a sequence of operations, and saves the final stack state to /tmp/stack.json.

Using curl and jq, find out what 'node_modules' directory the npm package 'minimist' would install into by getting its 'name' field from https://registry.npmjs.org/minimist and save it to /tmp/minimist_name.txt
Create a Python script that implements a simple rate limiter (token bucket algorithm) class, simulates 20 requests, and saves which ones were allowed/denied to /tmp/rate_limit.json.
Using curl and jq, retrieve the SHA-1 shasum of the latest tarball of the npm package 'commander' and save it to /tmp/commander_shasum.txt
Use curl to get the combined status of the latest commit on the main branch of 'octocat/Hello-World'.
Create a file /tmp/blanks.txt that has text lines interspersed with blank lines. Remove all blank lines and save to /tmp/no_blanks.txt.
Use curl to search for GitHub code containing 'def hello_world' in Python files across all public repos.
Write a Python script that reads environment variables, filters those starting with 'PATH' or 'HOME', and saves them as a JSON object to /tmp/env_vars.json.
Use curl to list the last 5 commits on the main branch of the 'git/git' repository on GitHub.
Write a Python script that computes the first 20 Fibonacci numbers and saves them as a JSON array in /tmp/fibonacci.json.
Using curl and jq, find the latest version of the npm package 'express' from the registry at https://registry.npmjs.org/express and write it to /tmp/express_version.txt
Use curl to list the workflow runs for the 'actions/runner' repository using the GitHub Actions API.
Use curl to get the license details for the 'MIT' license from GitHub's Licenses API.
Create a file /tmp/math.txt with one integer per line (10 lines). Calculate the sum and write it to /tmp/sum.txt.
Using curl and jq, find the license of the PyPI package 'scipy' from https://pypi.org/pypi/scipy/json and write it to /tmp/scipy_license.txt
Use curl to find which GitHub repositories depend on the 'lodash' npm package using the dependency graph API.
Using curl and jq, list all version numbers of the npm package 'chalk' from https://registry.npmjs.org/chalk and save them to /tmp/chalk_versions.txt (one per line)
Write a Python script that fetches https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos and saves the count of completed vs incomplete todos to /tmp/todo_stats.json.
Create a file /tmp/inventory.csv with columns 'item,quantity,price'. Calculate the total value (quantity*price) for each row and append as a new column in /tmp/inventory_total.csv.
Create a file /tmp/columns.txt with 3 space-separated columns and 5 rows. Extract the second column into /tmp/col2.txt.
Create a file /tmp/upper.txt with 5 lines of uppercase text. Convert all text to lowercase and save to /tmp/lower.txt.
Use curl to retrieve information about the 'Apache-2.0' license from GitHub's Licenses API.
Create a file /tmp/padded.txt with numbers of varying digit count. Left-pad all numbers with zeros to 5 digits and save to /tmp/zero_padded.txt.
Create a symbolic link /tmp/link.txt pointing to a real file /tmp/target.txt that contains 'I am the target'. Verify the link works by reading through it and saving content to /tmp/verify.txt.
Use curl to fetch all public gists of the GitHub user 'defunkt' and list their descriptions.
Using curl and jq, find the latest version and the publish date of 'moment' package on npm and save both to /tmp/moment_latest_info.txt
Fetch the list of teams in the 'github' organization that are publicly visible using curl.
Write a Python script that implements a simple template engine supporting {{variable}} substitution, processes a template with 3 variables, and saves the result to /tmp/template_output.txt.
